title: The Weekly Challenge - 396
task1_desc: You are given two array of integers, @order and @friends. The @order (size n) contains every integer from 1 to n exactly once. The @friends contains ID in sorted in strictly increasing order. Write a script to return the array containing IDs in finishing order.
task2_desc: You are given an array of integer. Write a script to return true if the given array is Trionic otherwise return false.
